title: AggregationResult
description: Result descriptor returned upon successful completion of a federated model aggregation.

modelId.description: Unique identifier of the aggregated model.

baseModelVersion.description: Version number of the base model that was aggregated from.

newModelVersion.description: Version number of the newly created model artifact.

updatesCount.description: Total number of updates included in the successful aggregation.

modelPath.description: Filesystem path to the newly created, published model artifact.
